richiami.difetto: Affected vehicles fitted with 1.9 RZ4E engines may under very specific driving conditions experience engine management control that may result in temporary emission irregularities.
richiami.rimedio: On the affected vehicles an update to the Engine Management Control unit software will be carried out

richiami.difetto: It has been found that the lower second steering shaft lower bolt may not have been tightened to the correct torque.
richiami.rimedio: Retighten the lower second steering shaft lower bolt to the correct torque value.
richiami.titolo: It has been found that the lower second steering shaft lower bolt may not have been tightened to the correct torque

richiami.difetto: Cracks may appear around the rear leaf spring bush eye.
richiami.modello: D-MAX CREW CAB , D-MAX CREW CAB
richiami.rimedio: Replace the rear leaf springs and handbrake cable.
richiami.titolo: CRACKS MAY APPEAR AROUND THE REAR LEAF SPRING BUSH EYE

richiami.difetto: Rear leaf spring front eye may fracture.
richiami.rimedio: Replace rear leaf springs on affected vehicles where necessary.
richiami.titolo: REAR LEAF SPRING MAY CRACK AT EYE BUSH ON SUSPENSION

richiami.difetto: Poor heat treatment to the camshaft gears may cause the teeth to break off and fall into the timing gear causing the engine to stop suddenly. This could increase the risk of collision.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the 1102 vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the camshaft and timing gear.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the connection block/shaft between the splined parts of the steering rack and steering column have not been manufactured to specification. This can result in the splines not engaging in the block/shaft sufficiently. This could lead to a disconnection of the steering column and steering rack which can result in loss of control of the vehicle.
richiami.modello: ARTIC TRUCK  AT35 , ARTIC TRUCK  AT35
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the connection block with a longer connector. The connector block is of a different size and shape
richiami.titolo: STEERING RACK/ STEERING COLUMN  CONNECTOR MAY DETACH

richiami.difetto: It is possible that the internal contact resistance of the crimped joints for the grounding between the throttle position sensor (TPS) and engine control module may increase due to engine vibration. This can lead to an increased TPS voltage output which could lead to an increase in engine revolutions whilst at idle without any throttle input.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles for the installation of a new wiring harness.

richiami.difetto: The front brakes may fail as a result of a fault in the brake master cylinder.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit new brake master cylinders.

richiami.difetto: When the vehicle is used continually and the seal breaks, losing its ability to lubricate, the front-suspension lower ball joint may wear over time and possibly fracture in the strut area. In the worst case, the front-suspension lower control arm may become loose, making steering more difficult.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the importer.  · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: When the vehicle is used continually and the seal breaks, losing its ability to lubricate, the front-suspension lower ball joint may wear over time and possibl…

richiami.difetto: Due to excessive clearance within the fuel injectors fuel may leak into the cylinder bores and then into the sump causing engine oil dilution. If this situation is ignored engine damage can occur additionally the engine revs may show an unintentional increase.
richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles will have the fuel injectors replaced.
richiami.titolo: DILUTION OF ENGINE OIL LEADING TO ENGINE DAMAGE

richiami.difetto: If the ceramic heater is used on full for an extended period of time the heater terminal may burn out. Although there have been no fires to date there is a very slight possibility that combustion could occur.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the likely to affected  vehicles and fit new terminals.
